assessment: This study conducts physiological recordings in awake mice to reveal how cerebellar Purkinje cells convey temporal information about the onset and offset of ongoing movements. There is a growing appreciation for the cerebellum in planned behavior, but how it contributes to a spontaneously initiated volitional behavior remained unclear. This work provides important insights into the roles of cerebellar Purkinje cells in regulating rhythmic movements under volitional control.
